title: Virgo fixed my zip before saying hi
caption: A Virgo flirts with repairs: your zip gets fixed before your name does. They remember the left molar and the Tuesday dentist. Notice the effort, ask what would make today lighter, and let them rest. Send this to the Virgo who fixed something of yours.
